title: One git hook blocked a fake GitHub token, so no secret hit history #Shorts
first_line: One gitleaks pre-commit hook blocked a fake GitHub token commit, so no secrets reached git history.
portability: Same technique with the pre-commit framework instead of .githooks, or Husky in other JavaScript repos, running gitleaks in either.

title: Claude Code invented one endpoint shape. A 3-line rule fixed it #Shorts
first_line: Claude Code invented one endpoint shape without a rule; a three-line CLAUDE.md rule made it ask first and write zero lines.
portability: Put the same three lines in AGENTS.md for Codex-style agents or in .cursorrules for Cursor instead of CLAUDE.md.

title: I don't trust an agent's restart. I trust a counter going up by one #Shorts
first_line: A fake server restart is caught by a counter that must go up by exactly one.
portability: Same technique with a Flask app and pytest instead of Express and a shell script, or a Go service and go test instead of node.

title: My subagent stopped halfway. One missing path was why #Shorts
first_line: My subagent stopped halfway because the test file sat outside its path scope.
portability: Same brief template, pytest instead of node --test, and a scoped Cursor rules file instead of a Claude subagent.

title: I let Claude Code test my Express API, then ran it myself three times
first_line: Watch one prompt take an untested Express API from zero tests to a passing node:test suite, with test count, failures and duration_ms on screen.
portability: Same technique on another stack: pytest instead of node --test, and go test with Go's testing package, both driven by the written contract and a no-weakening rule.

title: My mocked test passed. An 18-line check found the bug #Shorts
first_line: A mocked test passed, but the dialog still opened with focus on the close button. An 18-line script catches it.
portability: Same idea with Playwright instead of jsdom, and pytest instead of node test.

title: A mutant survived my tests. I deleted three lines, not wrote a test #Shorts
first_line: A mutant survived my tests, so I deleted three lines of code instead of writing a test.
portability: Same idea in Python with mutmut, or Java with PIT, running pytest or JUnit instead of node --test.

title: My subagent hook read an empty field. Now a bad report exits 2 #Shorts
first_line: My subagent hook read an empty field instead of the report. The fix reads the transcript and fails closed.
portability: Same technique in Python with pytest instead of node --test, or in Go with go test and a recorded JSON fixture.

title: My PM agent wrote no code. My first gate blocked a legal write
first_line: A PM agent planned three tasks and wrote no code, and a PreToolUse hook blocked the one write I forced outside its scope.
portability: Write the gate in Python and test it with pytest instead of node --test, or enforce the same scope at commit time with a pre-commit hook instead of a PreToolUse hook.

title: My Claude Code subagent hands back 4 lines. One named a skipped case #Shorts
first_line: A Claude Code subagent finishes and hands back exactly 4 lines, and the last one names a case it skipped.
portability: Same idea with any agent framework: a fixed output template in the agent prompt, and pytest instead of node --test.

title: I let a 12-line hook deny risky commands before Claude Code asks #Shorts
first_line: A 12-line Node hook denies a risky command before Claude Code shows any permission prompt.
portability: The same gate works with any CLI that has permission hooks: a Python hook script instead of Node, or a shell script with jq instead of a .cjs file.

title: I hit one .env deny rule three ways: Read, cat, grep #Shorts
first_line: One deny rule on .env, three read attempts (Read, cat, grep), and the tool line after each one is the verdict.
portability: Same technique with Codex CLI approval rules or Gemini CLI tool exclusions instead of Claude Code deny rules.

title: I wired 5 Claude Code hooks on a real repo. Two never fired
first_line: Five Claude Code hooks on a real repo, and the two that never fired until a one-line matcher fix.
portability: The same hook contract works in any stack: in a Python repo use python -m py_compile instead of node --check, and ruff or mypy instead of a JS linter, with the guard reading the same stdin JSON.

title: My agent tried a bad commit. One exit code stopped it, and it retried once #Shorts
first_line: A PreToolUse hook that exits with code 2 blocks a failing git commit, so the agent retries once instead of waiting for a review.
portability: Same technique with pytest instead of node --test, and a pre-commit hook or Husky instead of a Claude Code PreToolUse hook.
